_comment: Section → upload-artifact batch number, SSOT shared by deploy.yml (hand-authored 'Upload shard batch N dist' steps, IT + non-IT legs) and scripts/lib/rehydrate-section-shards.sh (ensure_batch_downloaded). GitHub Actions doesn't parallelize `uses:` steps (background:/wait-all: only works on `run:` steps — confirmed broken in production twice, PR #4777 reverted by #4779), so the 27 per-section `uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7` steps per leg are consolidated into 6 batch steps (~5 sections each) with a multi-entry `path:` instead. Keep in sync by hand when a section is added/removed from section-shard-slugs.json — batch numbers must be contiguous 1..N with no gaps for deploy.yml's step count to match.
